name: WHO ICTRP
description: The World Health Organization's International Clinical Trials Registry Platform: one search across national and regional trial registries.
coverage: About 1 million registrations from 17 primary registries (for example ClinicalTrials.gov, EU CTR, ISRCTN, the Chinese, Indian and Pan-African registries).
terms: Manual. WHO offers the ICTRP web service and full data set only on request; there is no open, keyless API. Key writes the search and opens the ICTRP search portal.

steps: Key opens the ICTRP search portal. Choose Advanced Search.
Paste the search Key copied for you into Condition or Intervention as fits; ICTRP takes AND, OR and NOT.
Set the recruitment status to All.
Choose Export results, all fields, as XML, and save the file.
ICTRP includes ClinicalTrials.gov registrations; Key merges those duplicates by their NCT number.
manual.importHint: Save the ICTRP export (XML) and import it into Key with File, Import.

guide.summary: ICTRP is the WHO's portal over national and regional trial registries. Use it next to ClinicalTrials.gov to find trials registered elsewhere, for example in Africa, India or China.
guide.coverage: About 1 million registrations from 17 registries worldwide.
guide.fields: ICTRP searches the title, condition and intervention fields; Key's search is written as plain AND, OR, NOT.
limits: No API: run the search on the portal and export the file.
The portal is sometimes slow or offline at busy times.
